Our Love Story

Sometimes, the most beautiful stories begin in the most unexpected ways.

Before we ever met in person, we started talking, and from that very first conversation, something just felt different. There was an instant spark and a comfort between us that made it feel like we had known each other for much longer. What started as a simple conversation quickly turned into hours of talking, laughing, sharing stories, dreams, and slowly getting to know each other.

From the beginning, we were also honest about the things that mattered most to us. Our faith was a big part of who we were, and it did not take long for us to realize just how much we shared. We had the same foundation, similar values, and the same desire to grow closer to God and one day build a family centered around faith and love.

Then came the day we finally met in person in California. And somehow, it did not feel like meeting someone for the first time. It felt familiar. The connection we had built through all those conversations was real, and being together only made it stronger.

Today, we are incredibly grateful for how God brought our paths together and for everyone who has been part of our journey. As we stand here surrounded by the people we love, we are excited to begin this next chapter together and to see where the rest of our story takes us.

“Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres. Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.”

1 Corinthians 13:4–8 NIV
